title: Page 2
content_zh:
一撤开置在叶慈顶上的大掌，叶润在众人都还没反应过来时，飞快地两手结印，再一掌狠狠击向自己心房，登时一口血自他发青的嘴中喷出，烫热的血液，其中几滴恰好落在刚睁开眼的叶慈面上。

「叶大人！」一旁苦候许久的神捕见状，赶紧上前左右搀住已撑不住，整个身子颓然往后仰倒的叶润。

方自浑沌中醒来的叶慈，双目呆滞地瞧着叶润犹置在心口的右掌，他怔怔地抬手抚上自己的面颊，感觉指尖传来的湿意，是那么的灼热。

他颤着声问：「师父，您做了什么？」

叶润喘息地倚在其中一名神捕的怀中，半垂着眼睫，适时地掩去了双目中流淌的精光。

「也没什么，就是……咳咳，顺手带些碍眼的人一块儿上路而已……」在司徒勤不得不自尽后，事前毫无半点准备的神宫，一时半刻间，定是找不着下一任转世宫主的。按以往的惯例来看，寻找下一任转世宫主，时间大多是在现任宫主将近晚年之时，然后花上一、二十年的时间来寻找。

可司徒勤死得太突然，又因司徒勤正当壮年，神宫自是尚未开始寻找下一任接替司徒勤的新宫主，在这等情况之下，神宫注定了往后将主位空悬一、二十年，那么在这段无主之期，也定然是司徒霜下手的最佳时机。

可他又怎能让司徒霜的狠子野心得逞呢？

那位司徒霜，也太不把他这位现任神官当一回事了。

既然司徒霜拉拢了祭司一派，欲让地位崇高的大祭司们为他皇袍加身，那么，他又为何不能毁去司徒霜手中能寻找并迫害转世宫主的筹码，为他的徒儿拖延上一段时日，让在宫中势力犹不稳的叶慈站稳脚步，并让叶慈成为目前神宫中地位最高者？

叶慈难以置信地问：「您……用了秘术？」

「为师倒要看看，司徒霜日后还有什么本钱同你叫板……」叶润虚弱地扯了扯唇角，很乐意拖几个同伴一道上路。

「可您要付出代价啊！」叶慈又惊又怒的低叫，「您会不能转世的您知不知道？」

「不要紧……」

「什么不──」

「小慈。」叶润打断激动得浑身都在颤抖的徒儿，殷殷向他嘱咐，「你受了为师的传承，你就是神宫新一任的神官了，从现在开始，你要统领西宫众神捕，主持神宫宫务，尽全力找出新宫主，并在新宫主上任后助他统领神宫，知道吗？」

「知道……」叶慈跪在他的面前执起他枯瘦的掌心，将它贴在自己的面庞上。

「你十五了，是个大人了，为师有幸，在你三岁时就找到了转世的你，有机会亲手将你培养长大……」叶润目光充满怀念地看着他年少清俊的脸庞，指尖留恋依依地抚过他的面颊，「咱们神官，此生唯一的主子就是神宫宫主，眼下你的宫主还在外头等着你呢，他还在等着你把他找回来，你莫让他在外头飘零太久。」

「徒儿定不负师命……」叶慈面上流落的泪水逐渐浸湿了他俩的掌心，让他渐渐再按不住叶润往下滑的掌心。

「很好……」叶润眼帘沉重地垂下双眸，「为师累了，想歇一歇……」当黎明再次到来，云取宫第十五世转世神官叶润亡于西宫，同日，数名大祭司亦暴亡于东宫。

她不记得那一场开启天下大乱的祸事是从何而来的，她亦不记得，以往那一段平淡幸福的日子又是如何被毁去的，唯一至今犹不能忘的，是那一日连云朵都似也要被烧红的漫天火光。

「姑娘，醒醒，快醒醒……」张婶顾不得此刻是否是夜半三更，而自家小姐又是否好梦正甜，伸手推着她，直要她快起。

「奶娘？」莫名被推醒的野风犹迷迷糊糊。

「出事了，老爷子要咱们快逃。」张婶压低了音量，快手快脚地扶起她，并迅速在她身上套上衣裳。

「出了什么事？外祖他……」她不解地看向邻院的窗扇，只见上头灯影幢幢，「外头是怎么回事？」

「姑娘快别问了。」张婶穿妥她的衣裳，又随手在一旁的书柜上抓了几本医书，分别塞进她俩的中衣里头。

「奶娘，这衣裳？」她低首看着身上有些陈旧的男装。

「是护院林大爷他孙子的。」随手替她挽了个男孩的发髻后，张婶拖着她的手走向小门，探首看了外头空无一人的后院后，便急急拉着她往后院处走。

飒冷的寒风刮在面上有如刀割，野风被疾走的张婶拖着走得踉踉跄跄，一离开后院，张婶便拖着她放开了步伐直往下山的小径跑，哪怕她跟不上或是跌了，也只是将她拉起再继续拖着她跑，待她俩走至林间的小径上时，山顶上已是人声鼎沸，一束束高举的火把将山顶照得明亮如昼。

野风边走边看向身后，「外祖……」

数月前，在中洲附近的国家，出现了一种似神非神的东西，名唤为魂纸，据传闻所言，任何人只要在魂纸上写下心愿并付出代价，应许而生的魂役就会为其主实现心愿。

初时听到这个流传了数个国家的传言，县城里的每个人的反应，不外乎是嗤之以鼻，或是耸耸肩不当一回事，只拿它当成一份茶余饭后的谈资罢了。可接下来，事情却出乎所有人预料，在邻国接连出现了魂役的踪影，且好几座大城相继覆灭在魂役之手，当各国的流民或逃灾的百姓，纷纷涌进他们这个临海小国时，原本还安逸谈论这份传言的人们，脸上再也兴不起半分笑意。

魂纸与魂役所带来的魂祸，就像是铺天盖地而来的瘟疫般，很快即席卷了整座大陆上的各国。被邻近各国视为最后一处避难之所的沙屿国，即使将国境关闭亦阻挡不住各国窜逃而来的百姓。随着日子一日日过去，就连他们这座位在沙屿国最偏远处的平波县城，亦出现了流民的踪迹。

身为平波县城的县太守，野浪为保县民安危，奉旨封闭平波县城，下令在魂祸引起的动乱结束前，整座县城许出不许进。然而即使是这样，高耸的城门依旧抵挡不住各式各样来历不明的魂役，与那一张张蛊惑人心的魂纸。

至于野风，也就是野浪的独生女，早在野浪听闻魂纸的消息后，即被野浪秘密送至山上外祖居处避祸，可他们皆没料到，哪怕此处再偏僻，离县城再遥远，最终此处还是遭到了波及。

「奶娘，咱们不等外祖？」眼看她们离山顶愈来愈远，满心不安的野风猛然扯住了张婶的手，说什么都不肯再往前头幽暗的密林走。

「不等，老爷子先前说了，要咱们先走。」张婶扯了她就要走，没时间跟她多作解释。

「可外祖他──」骤感不对的野风才想回头去找外祖，却猛然僵住了身子，一阵血腥的甜味直冲她口鼻之间。

这是……武者的威压？

在野风反应过来时，她迅速扑倒没有习过武，在受到武者威压后早已摇摇欲坠的张婶，然后趴在她的身后，探出两掌覆在张婶的心脉上护住，并运起内力，屏气凝神地看向林间的远处。

来者是士级高阶？不，那无与伦比的威压，怎么可能会只是士级高阶而已？难道说，那是传闻中的相级高手？

眼看强忍着痛苦的张婶呕了几口血，野风当机立断地撑扶起张婶，决定冒险先将张婶带离此处。只是她才拖着张婶走没多远，地上枯草的摩挲声响便出卖了她俩的行踪，几道黑影飞快地来到了她们的面前，堵住了她们的去路不说，其中一名领头的男子还扬首朝身后大嚷。
content_en:
As soon as he removed the big palm on Ye Ci's head, before anyone could react, Ye Run quickly formed a seal with both hands, and then hit his heart hard with another palm. A mouthful of blood spurted out from his blue mouth, and a few drops of the hot blood fell on Ye Ci's face, who had just opened his eyes.

"Master Ye!" Upon seeing this, the divine catcher who had been waiting for a long time on the side quickly stepped forward to help Ye Run, who could no longer hold on, and his whole body fell backwards.

Ye Ci, who just woke up from the chaos, looked at Ye Run's right palm with dull eyes, which was still on his heart. He raised his hand to touch his cheek, feeling the moisture coming from his fingertips, which was so hot.

He asked in a trembling voice: "Master, what have you done?"

Ye Run gasped and leaned in the arms of one of the gods, half-lidded his eyelashes, covering up the light flowing in his eyes in time.

"It's nothing, just... ahem, I just brought some unsightly people on the road..." After Situ Qin had to commit suicide, the shrine, which had no preparation in advance, would definitely not be able to find the next reincarnated palace master for a while.According to past practice, the search for the next reincarnated Palace Master was mostly done when the current Palace Master was nearing his old age, and then it took one to twenty years to search.

However, Situ Qin's death was too sudden, and because Situ Qin was in his prime, the Shrine had not yet begun to look for the next new palace master to succeed Situ Qin. Under such circumstances, the Shrine was destined to remain vacant for one to twenty years, so during this period of no master, it was definitely the best time for Situ Shuang to take action.

But how could he let Situ Shuang's ruthless ambition succeed?

That Situ Shuang didn't take the current priest seriously.

Since Situ Shuang has roped in the priests and wants the high priests to wear his royal robes, why can't he destroy the bargaining chip in Situ Shuang's hands to find and persecute the reincarnated palace lord, delaying his disciples for a while, allowing Ye Ci, whose power in the palace is still unstable, to gain a foothold, and make Ye Ci the highest-ranking person in the palace?

Ye Ci asked in disbelief: "You... used a secret technique?"

"I want to see if Situ Shuang can challenge you in the future..." Ye Run weakly tugged at the corner of his lips, willing to drag a few companions along with him.

"But you have to pay the price!" Ye Ci shouted in shock and anger, "Do you know whether you can be reincarnated?"

"It doesn't matter..."

"What not──"

"Xiao Ci." Ye Run interrupted his disciple who was shaking with excitement, and told him Yin Yin, "You have received the inheritance of being a master, and you are the new priest of the shrine. From now on, you will lead the gods of the West Palace, preside over the affairs of the shrine, do your best to find the new palace master, and help him rule the shrine after the new palace master takes office. Do you understand?"

"I know..." Ye Ci knelt in front of him, took his skinny palm, and put it against his face.

"You are fifteen, and you are an adult now. As a teacher, I am fortunate to have found you reincarnated when you were three years old, and to have the opportunity to raise you with my own hands..." Ye Run looked at his young and handsome face with nostalgia, and his fingertips caressed his cheek with nostalgia, "We priests, the only master in this life is the master of the palace. Right now, your master is still waiting for you outside. He is still waiting for you to find him. Don't let him wander outside for too long."

"Disciples will live up to their master's orders..." The tears flowing down Ye Ci's face gradually soaked their palms, making him gradually unable to hold Ye Run's palms down.

"Very good..." Ye Run lowered his eyes with heavy eyes, "I am tired of being a teacher and want to take a rest..." When dawn came again, Ye Run, the fifteenth reincarnated priest of Yundori Palace, died in the West Palace. On the same day, several high priests also died suddenly in the East Palace.

She doesn't remember where the disaster that started the world's chaos came from, and she doesn't remember how the peaceful and happy days in the past were ruined. The only thing that she can't forget is the fire that filled the sky that day that even the clouds seemed to be burned red.

"Girl, wake up, wake up quickly..." Aunt Zhang didn't care whether it was the middle of the night or whether her young lady was having a good dream. She stretched out her hand and pushed her, urging her to get up quickly.

"Nanny?" Yefeng was still in a daze after being pushed awake for no apparent reason.

"Something happened. The old man wants us to run away." Aunt Zhang lowered her voice, quickly helped her up, and quickly put on clothes on her body.

"What happened? Grandpa..." She looked at the window sash of the neighboring courtyard in confusion, and saw only the shadows of headlights above, "What's going on outside?"

"Girl, stop asking." Aunt Zhang put on her clothes, grabbed a few medical books from the bookcase nearby, and stuffed them into their coats.

"Nanny, these clothes?" She looked down at the somewhat old men's clothes on her body.

"It belongs to the grandson of Uncle Lin, who is guarding the courtyard." After casually pulling her hair into a boy's bun, Aunt Zhang dragged her hand towards the small door. After looking at the empty backyard outside, she hurriedly pulled her towards the backyard.

The cold wind blew on the face like a knife, and the wild wind was dragged by the running Aunt Zhang, making her stagger. As soon as she left the backyard, Aunt Zhang dragged her to run straight down the mountain path, even if she couldn't follow.If she went up or fell, he just pulled her up and continued to drag her running. By the time they reached the path in the forest, the top of the mountain was already bustling with people, and bunches of torches held high illuminated the top of the mountain as bright as day.

Yefeng looked behind him as he walked, "Grandpa..."

A few months ago, in the countries near Central Continent, something that looked like a god but not a god appeared. It was called soul paper. According to rumors, as long as anyone writes their wish on the soul paper and pays the price, the promised soul servant will fulfill the wish of the owner.

When I first heard about this rumor that had spread across several countries, everyone in the county's reaction was nothing more than to sneer or shrug and treat it as something to talk about after dinner.But what happened next was beyond everyone's expectations. Soul slaves appeared one after another in neighboring countries, and several big cities were destroyed by the soul slaves one after another. When refugees or people fleeing disasters from various countries poured into their small country by the sea, the people who had been talking about the rumors in peace no longer had any smiles on their faces.

The soul disaster brought about by soul paper and soul slavery was like an overwhelming plague that soon swept through all countries on the continent.The island country is regarded as the last refuge by neighboring countries. Even if the borders are closed, it cannot stop the people fleeing from all over the world.As the days went by, even in Pingbo County, the most remote part of Shayu Country, there were traces of refugees.

As the county magistrate of Pingbo County, Ye Lang was ordered to seal off Pingbo County in order to protect the safety of the people in the county. He ordered that the entire county was not allowed to enter until the turmoil caused by the soul disaster was over.However, even so, the towering city gate still cannot withstand all kinds of souls of unknown origin, and the soul papers that confuse people's hearts.

As for Ye Feng, Ye Lang's only daughter, after Ye Lang heard the news about the soul paper, she was secretly sent to her ancestral home on the mountain to avoid trouble. However, none of them expected that no matter how remote and far away from the county town, this place would still be affected in the end.

"Nanny, can't we wait for grandma?" Seeing them getting further and further away from the top of the mountain, the uneasy Yefeng suddenly grabbed Aunt Zhang's hand and refused to go any further into the dark forest ahead.

"No wait, the old man said before that we should leave first." Aunt Zhang asked her to leave and had no time to explain to her.

"But grandpa..." Yefeng, who suddenly felt something was wrong, wanted to go back to find her grandpa, but she suddenly froze, and a bloody sweet smell rushed directly between her mouth and nose.

Is this... the pressure of a warrior?

When Ye Feng reacted, she quickly threw down Aunt Zhang, who had never practiced martial arts and was already on the verge of collapse after being pressured by a warrior. Then she lay behind her, stretched out her two palms to cover Aunt Zhang's heart to protect her, mobilized her internal strength, and looked into the distance in the forest with breathless concentration.

Is the visitor a high-ranking soldier?No, how could that unparalleled pressure be just a high-ranking soldier?Could it be that he was the rumored prime minister?

Seeing Aunt Zhang vomiting a few mouthfuls of blood as she endured the pain, Yefeng immediately supported Aunt Zhang and decided to take the risk and take Aunt Zhang away from here first.But she had not dragged Aunt Zhang very far when the sound of dry grass on the ground betrayed their whereabouts. Several black shadows came quickly in front of them and blocked their way. One of the leading men raised his head and shouted behind him.
